अंशुमन झा-स्टारर Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business अब 6 नवंबर 2026 को दुनिया भर में रिलीज नहीं होगी।

मेकर्स के मुताबिक, फिल्म को अब early 2027 में बड़े पैमाने पर थियेट्रिकल रिलीज करने का प्लान है।

रणबीर कपूर की फिल्म Ramayana के साथ क्लैश से बचने के लिए यह फैसला लिया गया है।

हालांकि बेल्जियम में 7 नवंबर को Razor Reel Flanders Film Festival में इसका World Premiere होगा।

North America में डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन के लिए इसे नवंबर में American Film Market में भी ले जाया जाएगा।

साथ ही, अर्जुन बक्शी की कहानी को दोबारा दिखाने के लिए नवंबर से भारत के चुनिंदा सिनेमाघरों में पहला Lakadbaggha पार्ट भी री-रिलीज किया जाएगा। 🍿

ctx.text:
Anshuman Jha-starrer Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business will no longer be released worldwide on November 6, 2026. The film has been pushed to early 2027, with the makers looking to give the sequel a wider theatrical release.
The film will, however, have its World Premiere in Belgium on November 7 as part of the Razor Reel Flanders Film Festival, where it has been selected for the festival's programme. The change in theatrical plans comes as the film's original release date would have placed it in the same period as Ranbir Kapoor-starrer Ramayana .
According to the makers, the decision will allow them to plan a larger international and theatrical rollout for the sequel. The film is also expected to be presented at the American Film Market in November as the team explores distribution opportunities in North America for 2027.
While its worldwide theatrical release has been moved, Lakadbaggha 2 will still make its international debut during the Diwali period. Its screening at Razor Reel Flanders will mark the film's first public presentation ahead of its wider release.
The makers said in a statement, “We are thrilled to be premiering Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business during Diwali week in Belgium at Razor Reel Flanders. We are looking at a grander worldwide theatrical release in early 2027 for the sequel, giving the film the opportunity to reach audiences on a larger scale.”
The team is also planning to take the film to the American Film Market as it explores a wider release in North America next year.
Ahead of the sequel's eventual theatrical release, the makers will bring the first Lakadbaggha film back to select cinemas across India in November. The re-release will give audiences an opportunity to revisit the story of Arjun Bakshi, the character at the centre of the franchise.
The producers added, “In the meantime, we will be re-releasing Lakadbaggha Part 1 in select cinemas this November onwards, so audiences can revisit the birth story of our animal-lover vigilante franchise before Arjun Bakshi returns for his next adventure.”
Lakadbaggha 2: The Monkey Business will now target a worldwide theatrical release in early 2027, while the franchise's first film returns to select Indian screens in November.
